title: My Lovey-Dovey Wife is a Stone Cold Killer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An unnamed salaryman marries Setsuna after a short courtship and learns she is a professional assassin. He comes to accept her work, and the episodic comedy follows the newlyweds as she balances killing jobs with cooking, housework and learning to warm up to married life.
life_message: Love and acceptance can make a marriage work even when one partner has a startling secret.
